scope: Primary-research context for discussing experimental readouts; no instrument, actuator or new assay has been selected

papers.title: Opto-RhoGEFs, an optimized optogenetic toolbox to reversibly control Rho GTPase activity on a global to subcellular scale, enabling precise control over vascular endothelial barrier strength
verified_observations: The authors recruited the Rac GEF TIAM1 to the membrane using an iLID system and measured morphological responses.
Their optogenetic Rac experiment lacked a compatible reporter with enough dynamic range under the tested conditions; the paper does not establish absence of suitable Rac reporters in other setups.

papers.title: Cell-based optimization and characterization of genetically encoded location-based biosensors for Cdc42 or Rac activity
verified_observations: The study characterized location-based Rac and Cdc42 reporters and their specificity and response.
The Rac candidate CYRI-A had a modest relocation response that depended on imaging modality; reporter performance cannot be assumed from actuator recruitment alone.

model_to_experiment_inference: Both highlighted native WP/Goryachev inputs add a local inactive-to-active conversion coefficient. GEF recruitment is a concrete experimental route to discuss, but light intensity or membrane recruitment is not automatically the model input, and no quantitative optical mapping is claimed.
practical_implication: A proposed early activity signature needs a characterized activity readout as well as a characterized perturbation. Spatial domain/protrusion measurements remain distinct from Rac concentration or active-material amount.
